shadow_mode.description: Record route decisions without blocking legacy handlers.

enforce_ownership.description: Allow the kernel to stop handlers that do not own a turn.

proactive_rollout_percent.description: Stable percentage of activated private users eligible for event-driven proactive messages.

proactive_kill_switch.description: Immediately block all automatic proactive candidates without disabling passive continuity.

group_followup_seconds.description: How long an addressed group conversation remains active.

allowed_group_ids.description: Groups where configured community events may wake Xiaoning.

bot_sender_ids.description: Known bot sender IDs or names that must never count as human turns.

community_event_keywords.description: Explicitly configured group event keywords that may wake Xiaoning.
